segments.text: And that brings us to the final verdict. Will I personally apply for Reliance Geo IPO?
The answer is a simple no. Let me be 100% clear and also honest.
My decision not to apply has nothing to do with the quality of Geo's business.
Geo is arguably the most dominant, cash rich and fairly valued
mega cap asset to list in the Indian stock market in last decade.
If you are an IPO investor who receives allotment through regular or Reliance shareholder quota,
holding this company for next 5-10 years as an anchor compounding asset is entirely a rational
choice. However, my personal wealth building framework as always on being not long term,
it's a swing trading built on one important condition which is called 200DMA. Without seeing 200DMA
on the chart, I will never take a decision. Let me show you why this rule exists through
the real world case study of Zomato. When Zomato launched its IPO in July 2021,
the exact same media frenzy took place, the stock listed at 115 and shot up to 169,
millions of retail investors experienced intense FOMO and bought at the top.
Over the next 12 months, as pre-IPO anchor Loxin expired, the stock violently crashed 76%
hitting a devastating low of Rs 40. Investor who bought at the hype spent a year in sheer panic.
Because on listing day, a stock has zero technical history, zero moving averages and zero price
discovery. Usually in IPO on the listing day, it is an emotional battle between investment bankers
and short term flippers who expect the gamble on listing game. I am completely comfortable
letting the great fight and battle and gamble that is going to happen on listing day. I am happy
to let the listing pop pass by, let the 200DMA come and let me see what are all the strategies
that can be applied over the next 12 months. It will give us again an opportunity, then I will
enter when the strategy says yes, this is the time. I have learned in the market that I can always
afford to miss an opportunity, but I refuse to let greed compromise my discipline. If you found
value in this deep dive, hit the subscribe button which is free of cost and share it to your friend
who is actually also investing with you, who is deciding on the GEO IPO and drop your question
in the comments below. And as always, thanks for your time, thanks for your patience, happy investing.
